title: Musical family and her mother's singing
summary: Only Hilda and her father played; her mother sang for herself and is now 77.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: I'm trying to think if there's anything else we could ask. There's nothing else about his family that you could tell? Anyone else that was musical in the family?
No other than myself. We were the only two that played, you know that.
And his father as you say played guitar.
Yeah. Guitar, yeah. That's about the only one in the family that played. I started off my oldest son with a horn and he practiced about a year.
Did your mother play any musical instrument or sing or anything? Sing.

She would sing. She had a very nice voice. She had a very nice voice. But she didn't sing out with it. It was just amuse herself. Yes. But she does have a very nice voice. Mommy. At least she had. My mother's 77 now. Getting long in years. And my father would be 78 if he was little.
He wouldn't be so awfully old either.
No, he could have been here. He died quite young.
